nodes.name: Finalize Response
nodes.notes: Creates the only item shape allowed to enter the final Respond node: status_code plus public_response.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Architecture V2 uses this single Respond to Webhook node for every public outcome.

nodes.name: Execute Model Router V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Model Router V1. This node waits for one normalized result per input item.

parameters.content:
## Architecture V2 — Phase 3
The main workflow invokes one deterministic model router and remains provider-neutral. Trusted routing configuration lives only in Model Router V1. Strict LLM validation, deterministic scoring, public response construction, Finalize Response, and the single Respond node are unchanged. Clients cannot select a provider or model.
